description_en: Creates a trigger by calling CreateTrigger
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-trigger --project-id PE9FQC48 --namespace f323baa35c304751a4b1254adc8230bf --source / --file-ids 1,2 --function-ids 35,36 --invocation-mode 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrigger

parameters.help_en: The namespace, such as the namespace of syncstore
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The event identifier that activates the trigger, such as a syncstore path
parameters.help_zh: 触发器触发的事件标识，如：syncstore路径
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The file IDs of the files where the objective functions reside.

The file IDs correspond to the objective function IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
目标函数所在的文件ID。

与目标函数ID相对应，多个以英文逗号","分隔
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en:
The objective function IDs.

The function IDs correspond to the file IDs of the files where the objective functions reside. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
目标函数ID。

与目标函数所在的文件ID相对应，多个以英文逗号","分隔
parameters.name: function_ids

parameters.help_en:
The invocation mode. Valid values:

0: serial (synchronous) invocation
1: parallel (asynchronous) invocation
parameters.help_zh:
调用模式。

0：串行（同步）调用
1：并行（异步）调用
parameters.name: invocation_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger in the sandbox environment. Valid values:

0 (default): does not execute in this environment
1: executes in this environment
parameters.help_zh:
是否在沙箱环境触发。

0（默认）：不在该环境执行
1：在该环境执行
parameters.name: sandbox

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger in the production environment. Valid values:

0 (default): does not execute in this environment
1: executes in this environment
parameters.help_zh:
是否在生产环境触发。

0（默认）：不在该环境执行
1：在该环境执行
parameters.name: production
